description: Integration testing and verification: Create end-to-end test suite covering full workflows: search → scrape → resume → export, error recovery, rate limiting, and edge cases. Verify all FEATs work together and meet the original user requirements.
steps: Create /Users/mac/Documents/epubLegend/tests/e2e/scrape-workflow.test.ts with comprehensive integration test suite using Jest + mock HTTP responses: (1) test_search_returns_results (mock freewebnovel search page HTML, verify /api/search returns parsed results), (2) test_scrape_job_lifecycle (POST /api/scrape, poll progress, verify chapters cached), (3) test_scrape_resume_after_interruption (mock incomplete chapter, POST /api/scrape mode=resume, verify resumes from correct chapter), (4) test_scrape_handles_network_error (mock ECONNRESET, verify error in progress, resumable=true), (5) test_scrape_handles_rate_limit (mock HTTP 429, verify exponential backoff in progress), (6) test_export_epub_requires_3_chapters (create cache with 1,2,3 chapters, verify 422 for 2, success for 3), (7) test_export_pdf_generates_with_cover (mock cover image, generate PDF, verify contains cover page), (8) test_export_pdf_fallback_to_epub_if_puppeteer_unavailable (mock Puppeteer launch failure, verify 503 with helpful message)

Create /Users/mac/Documents/epubLegend/tests/e2e/user-journey.test.ts with user-centric workflow: (1) setup: clear downloads/ and db/novels.db before test, (2) user searches for 'solo leveling' -> /api/search returns 5 mock results with titles, authors, covers, (3) user clicks 'Start Scrape' on first result -> POST /api/scrape returns 202 with jobId, (4) user opens progress page, frontend polls every 1.5s, progress increments 0->25->50->75->100 over 5 seconds (mock timeline), (5) user sees '✓ Complete!' and clicks 'Export EPUB', -> POST /api/generate-ebook returns EPUB file stream, (6) user refreshes page, localStorage restores currentScrapeNovelId, progress still shows 100%, (7) user navigates to history, sees 'Solo Leveling' with download date

Create /Users/mac/Documents/epubLegend/tests/e2e/error-recovery.test.ts testing resilience: (1) test_resume_on_network_drop (scrape runs, reaches chapter 42, network drops, job status='paused', user calls POST /api/scrape mode=resume, resumes from chapter 42), (2) test_resume_validates_cached_chapters (cached chapters 1-42 complete + valid, 43 incomplete, resumes from 43, not 44), (3) test_retry_on_parse_error (chapter 30 has malformed HTML, Python logs error but continues, skips chapter 30, continues to 31), (4) test_orphaned_jobs_on_server_restart (simulate server crash by killing Node process, restart, check console for orphaned job warning), (5) test_duplicate_job_returns_409 (POST /api/scrape immediately followed by POST /api/scrape again, 2nd returns 409 with existing jobId)

Create /Users/mac/Documents/epubLegend/tests/e2e/rate-limiting.test.ts: (1) test_search_rate_limit_10_per_minute (make 11 POST /api/search requests in sequence, 11th returns 429), (2) test_scrape_queue_depth_limit (enqueue 20 jobs, 21st returns 503), (3) test_scrape_per_novel_concurrency_1 (start scrape for novel A, start scrape for novel A again immediately, 2nd returns 409), (4) test_max_concurrent_scrapes_3 (enqueue 5 jobs for 5 different novels, verify max 3 run concurrently in progress)

Create /Users/mac/Documents/epubLegend/tests/fixtures/mock-data.ts with reusable test data: (1) mockSearchHtml (realistic HTML from freewebnovel search results page), (2) mockChapterHtml (realistic chapter with content, ads, author notes), (3) mockNovelMetadata (title, author, description, cover URL), (4) mockJobProgress (current job state with chapters, completion %, timestamps), (5) mockFtw chapters (1-10 complete + valid, 11 incomplete, for resume testing)

Create /Users/mac/Documents/epubLegend/tests/setup.ts to initialize test environment: (1) before all tests: create temp db and downloads/ directories, (2) before each test: clear db tables and cached files, (3) after all tests: clean up temp directories, (4) setup mock HTTP server using jest.mock() for axios calls (so no live scraping during tests)

Create /Users/mac/Documents/epubLegend/tests/e2e/novel-metadata.test.ts testing metadata extraction: (1) test_novel_id_generation_is_deterministic (SHA256(url) always produces same id), (2) test_search_returns_novel_id_as_hash (verify novelId from search matches SHA256(url)), (3) test_get_novel_by_title_returns_exact_match_first (search for 'solo leveling', exact match appears before partial), (4) test_chapter_numbering_non_sequential (chapters 1, 5, 10 sort correctly by chapter_number, not inserted_order)

findings: Requires all previous FEATs (001-006) to be complete and functional. Tests should use mock data and mocked HTTP responses, not live scraping of freewebnovel.com.
